fragments.text: נֶחְצַב. לְהָב עֶלְיוֹן כָּל הַמַּחְצָב: מֵאַרְחוֹ כְּהַיּוֹם כֹּחַ הֻשָּׁה. נֶצֶר לְהַחֲנִיט לְתִשְׁעִים שָׁה. סִימָה אוֹת הֱיוֹת לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. עֲבוֹר לְפָנָיו בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה: פָּלְצוּ פְרָחֶיהָ

בְּזֶה יוֹם. צַנְחָם פְּנֵי כֵּס אָיוֹם. קוֹל רִנּוּנָם יִרְחֲשׁוּ כַהַיּוֹם. רוֹגְשִׁים לְהָרִיעַ לִמְצוֹא פִדְיוֹם: שְׁעוּנִים עָלֶיהָ בָּהּ לְהִפָּקְדָה. שׁוֹאֲנִים בְּדָפְקָם דְּלָתוֹת לְשָׁקְדָה. תְּמוּכִים בְּדֶשֶׁן שֶׂה עֲקֵדָה. תֶּשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נִפְקְדָה:

was he hewn, on him the whole structure is founded. His allotted wife was on this day granted vigour to bring forth a shoot at ninety years. She was set as an example for the roselike nation to appear before God at this beginning of the year. Her children tremble on this day while they stand before the awe-inspiring throne. They let their prayers be heard this day. They blow with a loud blast to find salvation. On her (Sarah) do they rely, to be considered for her sake, they cry out in assembly, knock at the gates, depend on the ashes of the sheep at the sacrifice of Isaac, the glorious gift with which she had been considered.
נַעֲלָה בְדִין עָלוֹת בִּתְרוּעָה. גֵּא עִם דָּרֶיהָ לְרוֹעֲעָה.
בְּשׁוֹפָר
(בְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפָר)
אֲפַתֶּנּוּ. וּבְבֶרֶךְ כְּרָעָה. בִּמְגִנַּת רֵעִים בְּגַנּוֹ אֲתְרוֹעֲעָה:
He rises in judgment, rising together with the loud blast, to shake the earth and its inhabitants. But with
the Shofar
(the memory of the Shofar)
I appease Him, and with bent knee, in the shelter of friends, will I sound in His garden (the Sanctuary) the shattering tone.

תַּאֲלַת זוֹ כְּחָפֵץ לְהוֹעִיל. שׁוּעַ עֲרוֹךְ לִמְּדָם לְהוֹעִיל. רוֹן הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם הַמּוֹעִיל. קְרוֹא בְגָרוֹן מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַגְעִיל: צִדְקָם לְהַקְפוֹת בְּנִיב שְׁוָעָה. פָּעֳלָם בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים לְשַׁמֵּעָה. עֵת רָצוֹן וְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה. סְבִיכַת קֶרֶן וּכְרוֹת שְׁבוּעָה: נוֹבְבִים בְּגִישַׁת הַיוֹמַת תִּשְׁעָה. מִסְפַּר שְׁמוֹת וְחוֹתְמֵיהֶן הַתִּשְׁעָה. לְמִנְיַן פְּלִיל שֵׁמוֹת הַתִּשְׁעָה. כְּתַחֲנַת עֲקָרָה יַלְדָּה שִׁבְעָה: יַאֲמִירוּ עֹז מַלְכוּת עֶשֶׂר. טְבוּעוֹת לְשֵׁם בָּחוּן בָּעֶשֶׂר. חֹק זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְקוֹלוֹת עֶשֶׂר. זֵכֶר מְבֹרָךְ

גְּבִיר בְּעֶשֶׂר: וַיֶּפֶן בָּאָהוּב אַחֲרוֹ נַהֲרִים. הֶעָקוּד בְּהַר מוֹר אַחֲרוּים. דִּשְׁנוֹ יַרְא לְחֵן שְׁחָרִים. גִּישַׁת עַנְיוֹ בֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם: בְּזֶה פֶּרֶק חוּג עֲתִירָה. בְּעַד אֲמוּרָה עַד הוּתָרָה. אֶנְקַת אָסִיר אָז כּוֹכְתָרָה. אֵלַי לְהֵעָתֵר כְּמוֹ נֶעְתָּרָה:

When He wished to heal the folly of His people, He taught them to arrange prayer so that it should be of help, the valued prayer of the primaeval mountains, to call aloud in order to scare the accuser. He taught them to affirm their righteousness with an outburst of entreaty, to recall at a time of favour and on the day of salvation their toil over the years, the ram caught in the thicket, the covenant and the oath. They recite the prayer with nine benedictions, nine is the number of blessings and their endings, according to the names of God in that prayer which the childless one (Hannah) uttered, who later gave birth to seven children. They revere in ten verses the acknowledgment of divine rule, they are based on him who was ten times tested (Abraham), the measure of remembrance and of Shofar tones is ten in memory of him who with ten blessings made his son master. May He gaze upon the beloved son of him who was brought out of Mesopotamia, who was bound hand and foot on Mount Moriah, let Him behold his ashes so as to be gracious to his descendants, who approach Him morning and noon. On this day he (Isaac) fervently entreated on behalf of his childless wife, until she too was remembered. As the sighs of the childless one were answered then, so let my prayer too be heard as hers was heard.
מֶלֶךְ בְּדִין עָלוֹת בִּתְרוּעָה. גֵּא עִם דָּרֶיהָ לְרוֹעֲעָה.
בְּשׁוֹפָר
(בְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפָר)
אֲפַתֶּנּוּ. וּבְבֶרֶךְ כְּרָעָה. בְּטַלְלֵי תְחִי בְּגַנּוֹ אֲתְרוֹעֲעָה:
The King rises in judgment with the loud blast to shake the earth with its inhabitants, but with
the Shofar
(the memory of the Shofar)
I appease Him, and with bent knee in the dew of revival will I sound in His garden the shattering tone.

אֶבֶן חוּג מָצוּק נְשִׁיָּה. תְּהוֹם רַבָּה עַל שִׁאִיָּה. בְּפִנַּת רֹאשׁ יְסוֹד שְׁלִישִׁיָּה. שָׁתֲתוּ שָׁעוּן בָּהּ לְשָׁשִׁיָּה: גִּנְפַּת שֵׁשׁ מְאוּמַת בָּנִים. רְבָעֶיהָ הַיוֹם מֵאַרְבָּעָה אֲבָנִים. דִּמּוּעַת מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנִים. קִשְּׁבָה מְנִיעִי אֵם הַבָּנִים: הָאַדְמוֹן כְּמַּט שֶׁלֹּא חָקַרָה. צָמָה לְקַחֲתָהּ לוֹ וְנִפְחָדָה. וּפִלְלָה רַבּוֹת בְּעַד הַתּוֹחֵלָה. פְּדוּתָהּ מִזֵּד וְלֹא חֻלָּלָה: זָכַר לָהּ יֹשֶׁר אֳרָחוֹת. עוּבָר לְהָמִיר בְּבֶטֶן אָחוֹת. חֻשְׁבָּה כַּהַיוֹם וְזָכְרָה לְהֵאָחוֹת. סוּקַף דִּינָה בְּיוֹסֵף לְהַנְחוֹת: טֶבַע בִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר הֶעֱבִיר. נִסֵּי חֲיָלִים לְהַנְעִים וּלְהַגְבִּיר. יָהּ כְּעֲתָרַת אֵיתָן גָּבִיר. מַטּוֹת שְׁנַיִם מִנָּה הִסְבִּיר: כַּעֲקֶרֶת בַּיִת כְּרָחֵל נָכְרִיָּה. כִּבְכוֹר רֵאשִׁית מִכֹּל נִפְרִיָּה. לְבָנֶיהָ תַעֲמוֹד בְּיוֹם זִכְרִיָּה. לְהִזָּכֵר כְּמוֹ נִזְכְּרָה:

The fortress of heaven, the foundation of the earth, the roaring waves of the deep flood, found their firm foundation through the first born son of the third mother (of our people). She, the root of our people, who lacked children and was today surrounded by her sister’s four sons, shed tears for children; then she heard divine comfort as a mother of children. When the tawny one (Esau) saw that she did not bear children, he hoped to possess her, then was she terrified. Fervently she prayed that his hope would not be fulfilled, that she might be delivered from the arrogant man and not be defiled. The Lord remembered the integrity of her ways, transformed the child in her sister’s womb; she was remembered today, for God recalled her sisterly affection and granted Joseph instead of Dinah. He changed nature as with a potter’s tool, to show the wonders of His strength and might. The Lord noted the plea of the strong (Jacob) and let two tribes emerge from her. As the barren woman of the household she was regarded as a stranger, but in the end a first born stemmed from her. May she protect her children on the day of remembrance, that they may be remembered as she herself was remembered.
זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים. וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים. לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם:
Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God, O King, helper, saviour and shield. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, shield of Abraham.
אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord, the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save.

מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:

Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling, healing the sick and releasing the captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.
מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים. וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים:
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion. And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who revives the dead.
יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:
The Lord will rule for eternity, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל
אֵל נָא:
And Thou, Holy One, dwellest above the songs of praise of Israel
, O God.
אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ:
גִּבּוֹר וְנַעֲרָץ. דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה:
הוּא שָׂח וַיֶּהִי. וְצִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ:
זִכְרוֹ לָנֶצַח. חַי עוֹלָמִים:
טְהוֹר עֵינַיִם. יוֹשֵׁב סֵתֶר:
כִּתְרוֹ יְשׁוּעָה. לְבוּשׁוֹ צְדָקָה:
מַעֲטֵהוּ קִנְאָה. נֶאְפָּד נְקָמָה:
סִתְרוֹ יֹשֶׁר. עֲצָתוֹ אֱמוּנָה:
פְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֱמֶת. צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר:
קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. רָם וּמִתְנַשֵּׂא:
שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים. תּוֹלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל בְּלִימָה:
חַי וְקַיָּם נוֹרָא בַמָּרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ:
Thou art our God in heaven and on earth.
Mighty and awe-inspiring distinguished among myriads.
He spoke and it came to pass, He commanded, then were they created.
His memory is forever, He lives in all eternity.
Pure is His gaze, He is enthroned in mystery.
His crown is salvation, His robe is righteousness.
His cloak is zeal, He is girded with retribution.
His mystery is equity, His counsel faith.
His work is truth, He is just and upright.
He is close to those who call Him in truth, lofty and exalted.
He resides in the clouds and suspends the earth in space.
Living, enduring, awe-inspiring, lofty and holy.
תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ. לְהַכְרִית כָּל־מֵרֵעַ. וְתִקָּדֵשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ:
Thou dost rise and let the trumpet sound to destroy every evil doer, and Thou art sanctified by those who know how to sound the Teruah, Holy One.
אַדֶּרֶת מַמְלָכָה. עַד מָה הֻשְׁלָכָה. וְעוֹד לֹא מָלְכָה: לְבֵל הִמְלִיכָה. וְאַחֲרָיו הָלְכָה. שֶׁלֹּא כַהֲלָכָה: עָלֶיהָ הַמְלָכָה. גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכָה. עַד תּוֹפִיעַ מְלוּכָה: וַכְלִילֵי

The glorious realm, how has it been cast down and not yet been restored to rule. It swore allegiance to Bel, it followed him against the law. Thus there gained dominion over it a mighty alien realm, until God’s realm will once again appear. It has burned my sanctuary, it has crushed my upright

instructions.text: חתום בראשי חרוזים אלעזר בירבי קליר.

fragments.text: שְׁמוֹ מְפָאֲרִים עֲדַת חֶבְלוֹ. וְנַעֲרִיץ בְּאֶרְאֶלֵּי קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלוֹ. וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כָּבוֹד אָמַר כּוּלּוֹ. קָדוֹשׁ:
שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְווֹתָיו עוֹד יְשׁוּבוּן לְבִצָּרוֹן. נִדְבָּרִים יְרֵאָיו בְּטֹהַר וְיִתְרוֹן. וַיַּקְשֵׁב יְיָ וַיִּשְׁמַע וַיִּכָּתֵב בְּסֵפֶר זִכָּרוֹן. קָדוֹשׁ:
שַׁפְּרוּ מַעֲשִׂים וּבְרִית לֹא תוּפָר. נַאֲקַתְכֶם יַאֲזִין שְׁחָקִים שִׁפַּר. וְתִיטַב לַיְיָ מִשּׁוֹר פָּר. קָדוֹשׁ:
His Name is praised by the community of His portion, His praise is proclaimed by the holy Erelim and in His sanctuary everything utters glory of the Holy One.

Those who observe His commandments will yet return to the fortress, those who fear Him, speak to one another in purity and bliss, and the Lord has listened and heard and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance, the Holy One.
Improve your deeds that the covenant may not be broken, He who has adorned the skies, will hear your cry, and it will be more pleasing than the sacrifice of oxen to the Lord the Holy One.

repetition_german_frankfurt.text: אין פֿפֿד״מ ווירד דיעזעז ניכֿט געזאַגט, מאַן בעגיננט גלייך מיט תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ.

repetition_german_shabbat.text: אַם שַׁבָּת ווירד דאַ: אונטענסטעהענדע שְׁמוֹ מְפָאֲרִים געבעטעט.

repetition_metz.text: בק״ק מיץ אין אומרים חרוז תריע.
